inventory.visualPurpose: The four-panel synapse figure (book 238): the cholinergic, noradrenergic, serotonergic, and dopaminergic synapses with every synthesis chain, transporter, cleft-clearance route, drug banner, and postsynaptic receptor — the master target map of autonomic pharmacology
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: VECTOR LINE ART, no raster (pdfimages: ZERO raster images on pdf 260, CONFIRMED; VLM available this session — four passes at 120 + 200 DPI including per-panel crops, saved to staging-ph15/vlm-census.txt): a page-dominating 2×2 grid of four synapse cartoons. CHOLINERGIC (top-left): ChAT joining Choline + Acetyl-CoA into ACh; vesicles; a Ca2+ channel with a green ⊕ to the release site; the red-bannered 'Cholinergic inhibitor — Botulinum toxin' whose red ⊖ terminates on the release machinery; the cleft enzyme AChE splitting ACh into Choline + Acetate; the green-bannered 'Cholinergic stimulant — AChE inhibitors eg, Donepezil' whose red ⊖ lands on AChE; postsynaptic M1, M2, M3 under 'Cholinoreceptors'. NORADRENERGIC (top-right): Tyrosine → DOPA → Dopamine in the cytoplasm, Dopamine → NE crossing the vesicle membrane via VMAT; 'Vesicular monoamine transporter (VMAT) inhibitor — Tetrabenazine' (⊖ on VMAT); the 'Releasemodulating receptors' bracket grouping AT II (⊕) and α2 (⊖) with the dashed 'Negative feedback' curve from the cleft NE; 'Noradrenergic stimulant — Amphetamine, Ephedrine' (⊕ release); NET with its cleft→terminal 'Reuptake' arrow blocked by 'Noradrenergic stimulant — Amphetamine, SNRIs, Cocaine, TCAs, MDMA' (⊖ on NET); 'Diffusion, metabolism' leaving the cleft; postsynaptic α and β under 'Adrenoreceptors'; Ca2+ channel. SEROTONERGIC (bottom-right): Tryptophan → 5-Hydroxytryptophan → 5-HT; SERT + 'Reuptake' blocked by 'Serotonergic stimulant — Amphetamine, SNRIs, Cocaine, SSRIs' (⊖ on SERT); postsynaptic '5-HT receptor'; NO Ca2+, NO inhibitor banner. DOPAMINERGIC (bottom-left): Tyrosine → L-DOPA → Dopamine; DAT + 'Reuptake' blocked by 'Dopaminergic stimulant — Amphetamine, Methylphenidate, Cocaine' (⊖ on DAT); postsynaptic 'Dopamine receptor'; NO Ca2+, NO inhibitor banner. A small publisher logo prints at the lower right of the serotonergic panel (not reproduced).
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual (AutonomicSynapseMap in visuals/pharm-p15.tsx): four vertical panels (cholinergic | noradrenergic | serotonergic | dopaminergic — the source's 2×2 layout re-laid-out vertically per the production spec), each carrying the axon terminal with its synthesis chain and vesicle, the Ca2+ channel where the source prints one (cholinergic + noradrenergic only), the synaptic cleft with its clearance route (AChE → Choline + Acetate for cholinergic; NET/SERT/DAT Reuptake + Diffusion, metabolism for the amines), the drug-anchor chips with their exact printed ⊖/⊕ terminations, the postsynaptic receptor row, the class banner(s) as printed, and an at-this-synapse exam note; the noradrenergic panel additionally carries the α2/AT II release-modulating bracket with the dashed negative-feedback loop and the four-step amphetamine reverse-transport strip (the printed paragraph, rendered as annotated steps and labeled as such); the printed labels are also carried verbatim in the note's label table (blocks[2]) and the two intro paragraphs verbatim in blocks[1]
